```sql
WITH Czech_Discount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM gasstations gs
    WHERE gs.Country = 'CZE' AND gs.Discount = 1
),
Slovakia_Discount AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM gasstations gs
    WHERE gs.Country = 'SVK' AND gs.Discount = 1
)
SELECT c2.cnt - s2.cnt as diff
FROM customers c2, "transactions_1k" t, gasstations gs
WHERE t.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID 
   AND gs.Country = 'CZE'
   AND gs.Discount = 1
   AND gs.Country IN ('CZE', 'SVK')
   AND t.Date >= DATE('2024-01-01')
   AND t.Date < DATE('2024-12-31')
```


```sql
SELECT DISTINCT e.element AS element, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) as bond_count
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bonded b ON a.atom_id = b.atom_id2 AND b.bond_id IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN bonded b2 ON a.atom_id = b2.atom_id2 AND b2.bond_id IS NOT NULL
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
GROUP BY e.element
ORDER BY e.element ASC
LIMIT 3;
```


```sql
SELECT 
    atom.label,
    (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = atom.molecule_id AND element = 'carcinogenic') AS toxicology_element
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM molecule
    GROUP BY molecule_id
```



```sql
WITH CustomerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalConsumption,
        AVG(t.Price) AS AvgPricePerUnit,
        COUNT(*) AS CountOfUnits
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN "yearmonth" y ON t.Date = y.Date AND t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
CustomerBySegment AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM CustomerStats
    ORDER BY Segment, CustomerID
),
YearAverageConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        COALESCE(AVG(Consumption), 0) AS AnnualAverageConsumption
    FROM CustomerBySegment
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
YearAverageConsumptionLAMKAMASMEXE AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        COALESCE(AVG(Consumption), 0) AS AnnualAverageConsumption
    FROM CustomerBySegment
    WHERE Segment IN ('LAM', 'KAM')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        COALESCE(AVG(Consumption), 0) AS AnnualAverageConsumption
    FROM CustomerBySegment
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'SME')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        COALESCE(AVG(Consumption), 0) AS AnnualAverageConsumption
    FROM CustomerBySegment
    WHERE Segment IN ('LAM', 'KAM')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        COALESCE(AVG(Consumption), 0) AS AnnualAverageConsumption
    FROM CustomerBySegment
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'SME')
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS SMEAnnualAvg,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS LAMAnnualAvg,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS KAMAnnualAvg,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS SSMEXEAnnualAvg
FROM YearAverageConsumptionLAMKAMASMEXE
WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'SME')
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS SMEAnnualAvg,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS LAMAnnualAvg,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS KAMAnnualAvg,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS SSMEXEAnnualAvg
FROM YearAverageConsumptionLAMKAMASMEXE
WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'SME')
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS SMEAnnualAvg,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS LAMAnnualAvg,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS KAMAnnualAvg,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverageConsumption ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / 4 AS SSMEXEAnnualAvg
FROM YearAverageConsumptionLAMKAMASMEXE
WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'SME');
```


```sql
SELECT 
    h.full_name AS hero_name,
    h.height_cm,
    p.publisher_name
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.hair_colour_id = c2.id
JOIN colour c3 ON s.skin_colour_id = c3.id
JOIN colour c4 ON s.gender_id = c4.id
JOIN colour c5 ON s.race_id = c5.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
```

```sql

JOIN member m ON e2.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e2.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha Harrison' AND m.last_name = 'Harrison';
```





```sql
SELECT 
    s.full_name,
    COALESCE(s.eye_colour_id, NULL) AS eyes,
    COALESCE(s.hair_colour_id, NULL) AS hair,
    COALESCE(s.skin_colour_id, NULL) AS skin_color
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.gender_id = 1 -- Assuming 'Female' corresponds to gender_id = 1 in this schema
```

```sql
SELECT 
    m.member_id,
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,

    m.phone AS member_phone,

    CASE WHEN b.approved = true THEN 'Approved' ELSE 'Not Approved' END AS approval_status
```

```sql
SELECT 
    EXE.ID AS Examination_ID,
    EXE.Examination_Date,
    LLD.IGG,
    LLD.IGM,
    LLD.IMG,
    LLD.CRP,
    LLD.RA,
    LLD.RF,
    LLD.C3,
    LLD.C4,
    LLD.RNP,
    LLD.SMA,
    LLD.SC170,
    LLD.SSB,
    LLD.CENTROMEA,
    LLD.DNA,
    LLD.DNA-II
FROM Examination EXE
JOIN Patient P ON EXE.PATIENT_ID = P.ID
LEFT JOIN Laboratory LLD ON LLD.LABORATORY_ID = EXE.LABORATORY_ID AND LLD.DATE = EXE.EXAMINATION_DATE
WHERE P.ID = 30609;
```

```sql
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, d.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
AND e.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT E.Diagnosis, P.Description, 
       MIN(P.Birthday) AS Age,
       E.Examination Date,
       'Youngest Patient' AS Diagnosis_Name
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE (E.ACL_IgG IS NOT NULL OR E.ACL_IgM IS NOT NULL OR E.ACL_IgA IS NOT NULL)
  AND (E.ANA IS NOT NULL OR E.ANA_PATTERN IS NOT NULL)
  AND (E.KCT IS NOT NULL OR E.RVVT IS NOT NULL)
  AND (E.LAC IS NOT NULL OR E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL)
  AND (E.Thrombosis IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY E.Diagnosis, P.Description, MIN(P.Birthday), E.Examination Date
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN publisher.id = 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id

WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180
GROUP BY s.id
```


```sql

```

```sql
SELECT 
    P.ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS patients_with_normal_sm
FROM Patient P
LEFT JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.Patient_ID
WHERE (E.ANA_PATTERN LIKE '%0%' OR E.ANA_PATTERN IS NULL)
  AND (E.SM IN ('-', '+-') OR E.SM = '0')
GROUP BY P.ID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) > 1;
```

```sql
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS INTEGER) AS Male_Patients_Outpatient,
       CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS INTEGER) - CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS INTEGER) AS Male_Patients_Inpatient;

-- Explanation of the query logic:
-- 1. We join Patient (P) and Examination (Ex) to get specific rows where Admission is '+' (in-patient).
-- 2. We select only Sex = 'M' from those rows.
-- 3. We count the total number of such males in-in-patient patients.
-- 4. We do the same for '-' (outpatient) admissions.
-- 5. The difference between the two counts gives us the percentage deviation relative to the total number of males admitted.
```

```sql
FROM Examination e 
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID 
WHERE e.Examination Date >= '1990-01-01' AND e.Examination Date <= '1993-12-31' 
AND p.Birthday < 18;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT64) / COUNT(*) * 100.0, 2) AS PERCENTAGE
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
```

```sql
SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    (SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(p.Birthday))) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination ex ON p.ID = ex.Patient_ID
WHERE 
    (p.GLU >= 180) AND 
    (ex.T-CHO < 250);
```

```sql
SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.Description,
    p.Birthday,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.FIRST_DATE) * 12 + EXTRACT(DAY FROM p.FIRST_DATE) AS WeekNumber,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.FIRST_DATE) AS Year,
    t.LAC,
    t.T-BIL,
    t.GOT,
    t.GPT,
    t.PIC,
    CASE 
        WHEN t.T-BIL < 2.0 THEN 'Normal' 
        ELSE 'Abnormal' 
    END AS Status
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.PatientID
JOIN Laboratory t ON p.ID = t.PatientID AND Date = '1991-10%'
WHERE e.ADMISSION = '-';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
    ) AS Percentage,
    'F'
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE SUBTRACT(year(e.Examination Date), year(p.Birthday)) > 55
AND e.`aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL AND e.`aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL
AND e.ANA != NULL AND e.ANA Pattern IS NOT NULL
AND e.Sex = 'F';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE NULL END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE NULL END) AS Total_Cholesterol_Decentation_1981,
    CASE 
        WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE NULL END) - 
              SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE NULL END)) / 
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE NULL END) > 0.05 
        THEN 'Decrease' 
        ELSE 'No Significant Change' 
    END AS Outcome
```

```sql
WITH race_data AS (
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        s.year,
        r.name as race_name,
        c.name as constructorName,
        c.nationality,
        COUNT(dr.driverId) as driverCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dr.number > 0 THEN dr.points ELSE 0 END) as totalPoints
    FROM races r
    INNER JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
    INNER JOIN constructors c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    LEFT JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
    GROUP BY r.raceId, s.year, r.name, c.name, c.nationality
),
constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        constructorId,
        MAX(totalPoints) as maxPoints,
        constructorName,
        nationality
    FROM race_data
    GROUP BY constructorId, constructorName, nationality
),
max_constructor AS (
    SELECT * FROM constructor_totals
    ORDER BY maxPoints DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    c.maxPoints as score,
    c.name as name,
    c.nationality as nationality
FROM constructors c
INNER JOIN max_constructor mc ON c.constructorId = mc.constructorId;
```

```sql
        dr.driverId,

countNotFirstRow AS (
```

```sql
WITH OverallRatings AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(p.player_api_id AS REAL) * 100.0 / p.height AS player_percentage,
        overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes p
    JOIN Player p ON p.id = p.player_fifa_api_id OR p.id = p.player_api_id
),
PlayersWithOverall AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        player_name,
        player_api_id,
        date,
        overall_rating,
        player_percentage
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        id,
        player_name,
        player_api_id,
        date,
        overall_rating,
        player_percentage
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
),
LeagueMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.id,
        c.name AS country_name,
        l.name AS league_name,
        s.phase,
        s.date,
        o.player_percentage,
        o.overall_rating
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Player_Attributes p ON m.home_player_X1 = p.id OR m.home_player_X2 = p.id OR m.home_player_X3 = p.id OR m.home_player_X4 = p.id OR m.home_player_X5 = p.id OR m.home_player_X6 = p.id OR m.home_player_X7 = p.id OR m.home_player_X8 = p.id OR m.home_player_X9 = p.id OR m.home_player_X10 = p.id OR m.home_player_X11 = p.id
    JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_1 = p.id OR m.home_player_2 = p.id OR m.home_player_3 = p.id OR m.home_player_4 = p.id OR m.home_player_5 = p.id OR m.home_player_6 = p.id OR m.home_player_7 = p.id OR m.home_player_8 = p.id OR m.home_player_9 = p.id OR m.home_player_X1 = p.id OR m.home_player_X2 = p.id OR m.home_player_X3 = p.id OR m.home_player_X4 = p.id OR m.home_player_X5 = p.id OR m.home_player_X6 = p.id OR m.home_player_X7 = p.id OR m.home_player_X8 = p.id OR m.home_player_X9 = p.id OR m.home_player_X10 = p.id OR m.home_player_X11 = p.id
    JOIN Player p ON m.away_player_1 = p.id OR m.away_player_2 = p.id OR m.away_player_3 = p.id OR m.away_player_4 = p.id OR m.away_player_5 = p.id OR m.away_player_6 = p.id OR m.away_player_7 = p.id OR m.away_player_8 = p.id OR m.away_player_9 = p.id OR m.away_player_X1 = p.id OR m.away_player_X2 = p.id OR m.away_player_X3 = p.id OR m.away_player_X4 = p.id OR m.away_player_X5 = p.id OR m.away_player_X6 = p.id OR m.away_player_X7 = p.id OR m.away_player_X8 = p.id OR m.away_player_X9 = p.id OR m.away_player_X10 = p.id OR m.away_player_X11 = p.id
    JOIN Player p ON m.home_player_Y1 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y2 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y3 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y4 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y5 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y6 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y7 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y8 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y9 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y10 = p.id OR m.home_player_Y11 = p.id
    JOIN Player p ON m.away_player_Y1 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y2 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y3 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y4 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y5 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y6 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y7 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y8 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y9 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y10 = p.id OR m.away_player_Y11 = p.id
),
AverageRating AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(player_percentage) * 100.0 + AVG(overall_rating) AS average_percentage,
        AVG(overall_rating)
    FROM LeagueMatches
),
MaxRating AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(player_percentage) * 100.0 + MAX(overall_rating) AS max_percentage,
        MAX(overall_rating)
    FROM LeagueMatches
),
DifferenceRatio AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(MAXPercentage - MINPercentage, 0) / MAXPercentage * 100.0 AS percentage_difference
    FROM AverageRating
),
FinalComparison AS (
    SELECT 
        d.percentage_difference
    FROM DifferenceRatio d
),
Result AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(d.percentage_difference, 2) AS higher_by_percentage
    FROM FinalComparison
)
SELECT result.higher_by_percentage;
```
